```php
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

Route::get('/', function () {
    return view('welcome');
});

Route::get('/dashboard', function () {
    return view('dashboard');
});

Route::get('/url', function () {
    return view('url');
});
```

This code snippet defines the routes for your URL-shortener-app application in Laravel. Each route maps a specific URL to a corresponding Blade template located in the `resources/views` directory.
